newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES STABLE TO WEAK ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES STABLE TO WEAK ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted stable on the U.S. unit and the rand but closed weaker against European currencies after Thursday's quiet interbank session.
Dealers said the local unit finished the day at 10.8600/8750 against the key U.S. dollar, where it closed on Wednesday, and was also largely stable 2.3300/3357 against South Africa's rand.

Against pound sterling however, it lost to 18.2020/2420 from late Wednesday's 18.1730/2090, tracking a weaker U.S. currency overseas and was also easier on the German mark at 6.8110/8240 compared to 6.7960/8090 the previous day.
